A 46-year-old woman undergoes endoscopic transthoracic anterior surgery for a herniated disk in the
thorax. What is the most likely complication following surgery? Answer Choices: (A) Chylothorax (B)
Hemothorax (C) Intercostal neuralgia (D) Esophageal perforation (E) Rib fracture (F) Postoperative
atelectasis (G) Pseudarthrosis (H) Pleural effusion (I) Diaphragmatic paralysis (J) Pneumothorax
 A. Chylothorax
B. Pleural effusion
C. Pneumothorax
D. Pseudarthrosis
E. Rib fracture
F. Hemothorax
G. Esophageal perforation
H. Intercostal neuralgia
I. Postoperative atelectasis
J. Diaphragmatic paralysis
